comment: EPO03 accepted atlas regions for team west, in blit order. A region appears here ONLY after the single-defect loop ACCEPT (generate -> composite -> guards -> full atlas + x2 perimeter + 197x426 phone FOV -> verdict). Fields: id, x, y, w, h (crop origin/size on the 1024^2 atlas; <id>.png and <id>_mask.png are exactly w x h), salt (>= 40, unique across all five manifests), status, job, seed, atlas, review, team, reauthorizes (landmark golden ids this region overwrites; each is re-extracted in the same commit — DECISIONS/0033).

regions.name: core_face_upper
regions.intent: The core forest's west face above the road (the vertical wall at x~256, y 300-494, inside the A-4 rim FMPO02 could not write) breaks westward into bays, promontories and stepping copses that meet W1's meadow copses; firs at the top, oaks below; the wood east of x 296 stays unbroken for the fairy glade; Greenwatch (286,431) keeps a forest edge.

regions.name: pass_road_foothills
regions.intent: PLAINS->MOUNTAIN (DIR-02): the road loop gets a reason. The existing road geometry is held (enters the west edge at y=602, col at Wayfarer's Pass 187,542, corridor 199-245 x 506-532 keeps road, leaves x=260 at y=517) and the terrain around it is re-authored: rock knolls and scree fans rising westward to the Worldspine's foot, boulders densest at the wall, a snow dusting on the SW shoulders; a beck out of the hills forded by the road and bending SW to leave the rect bottom for WC; the pasted peak (210,590) joined to the range by a rock-and-scree ridge. Rect stops at x=260 so the frozen core wood, Deepwood Shrine (304,556) and LANDMARKS' L1 glade (256-464 x 352-544) are untouched.

regions.name: downs_bridge_south
regions.intent: The bridge region over the y=700 join with SOUTH, and the cure for the pale dead slab above it. The dead downland (atlas 20-200 x 620-720, dominant #9dab70 at 9.2% and almost no marks) gets gorse, bracken, heather, tussock and boulder trains reaching out of the crag on the left; S3's wood, whose north edge runs near-horizontally at y~720, breaks north into bays, promontories and stepping copses so no line can be drawn where it ends; and WB's beck, which stops dead at (193,620), is carried south-west through the heath and into the wood. Both sides of the join are inside the rect (60 px above y=700, 40 px below) with 40 px frozen beyond each - the ATLAS_PRODUCTION_RULES §3 bridge, not a re-touch of S3.

regions.name: core_face_lower
regions.intent: The residual of DIR-01 verdict 2, below WA: measured on the shipped composite the canopy edge holds x=238-271 across y 490-600 (a 33 px wander over 110 px of height - a quasi-vertical wall) and a dither column of scattered dark pixels runs down atlas x~264-270 from y 540 to 640. The edge is broken into bays, promontories and stepping copses meeting WB.s outcrop meadow and WC.s downs; the dither column goes; the road through the rect is frozen by a custom inpaint mask (WD_inpaint_mask.png) so the three goldens keep road under them; the wood east of x=296 stays dense so Deepwood Shrine (304,556) and Whispering Woods keep deep wood.
